mango.config.chunkBufferScale.tooltip: Terrain buffer size. Higher values use more memory. (1-4)
mango.config.enableFrameGeneration.toolt: Generates extra frames for smoother motion. Adds some latency and may cause visual artifacts.
mango.config.frameGenerationMultiplier.t: Output frame multiplier. Higher values are smoother but may add latency and artifacts. (2-4)
mango.config.enableHiZCulling.tooltip: Skips terrain hidden by nearby geometry. Faster, but fast camera movement may cause a one-frame flicker.
mango.backendWarning.title: Mango Requires the Vulkan Backend
mango.backendWarning.message.line1: Mango is currently running on the OpenGL backend.
mango.backendWarning.message.line2: Mango's optimizations are not enabled on OpenGL. Switch to the Vulkan backend to enable them.
mango.backendWarning.message.line3: The game will quit after switching; restart to apply the change.
